card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit of a section number inside parentheses, such as the 5 in (5.5) or 7 in (7.2), in cross-references to Warnings and Precautions or Drug Interactions in drug labels.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: Leading digit of a section number in parentheses after a warning or interaction statement.

modes.label: Bare section digit
modes.description: A single section number in parentheses with no decimal part, closing a highlights statement.

card.plain: It fires on the section number in the brackets that point readers to another part of the drug label.
